added_lines: . We look forward to seeing you all on 2nd December for an enjoyable afternoon of festive celebrations. Merry Christmas and best wishes to everyone! Christmas Mass Cards Milford & Kerrykeel A selection of Parish Christmas Mass Cards are on sale. They are available in the Sacristy before or after Mass for the next few weeks. These are shared Mass Intention Cards and Masses will be offered in the Parish on the week leading up to Christmas. The cards are in a pack of 6 and the cost is €5 per pack. Proceeds from the sale of the cards will be lodged to the Parish Account. Cleaning in Our Lady of Lourdes Church In preparation for Christmas, a cleaning evening will take place in Our Lady of Lourdes, Church, Kerrykeel on Wednesday 2nd December at 6:30pm . All help would be greatly appreciated. Christmas 2026 Masses Times St Joseph’s Church, Rathmullan: Christmas Eve : 4:00pm & 8:00pm. Christmas Day: 9:00am. St Peter’s Church, Milford: Christmas Eve : 4:00pm & 8:00pm. Christmas Day: 11:00am. St Catherine's Church, Oughterlin: Christmas Day: 11:00am. Our Lady of Lourdes Church, Kerrykeel: Christmas Eve: 6:00pm. Christmas Day: 9:30am. Star of The Sea Church, Glenvar: Christmas Eve : 6:00pm. Please note: The 4:00pm Mass, in St Peter’s Church, Milford & St Joseph’s Church, Rathmullan are Children’s Masses. We Can Change Fr Eamonn Kelly’s new book, We Can Change, contains reflections on his amazing trip to Malawi. Fr Kelly will do a book signing in St Paul’s, Main Street Letterkenny on Monday 7th December at 11am and all are welcome. Volunteers Required Would you like to support your local community? The Ray Community Group are looking for people who would be interested in supporting some of the activities at Ray Community Centre in a voluntary capacity. If this sounds like something you would be interested in, please get in touch. Milford & Rathmullan

. Ballybofey, Stranorlar & District Historical Society: our next meeting will take place in the Henderson Hall (F93 XV29) Stranorlar on Monday No- vember 23rd. This month's talk will be by Florence Blackburn on The Tenants, Their Landlord & His Land Bailiff - Outrage In Cloghan 1847. The Society's members meeting will take place from 7 - 8pm, & the talk will take place at 8pm in the main hall. The talk is free and is open to everyone. for further details. Christmas Crib in a Shoebox: Children & Parents are invited to make a Christmas Crib in a shoebox in the Parish Centre on Saturday December 5th at 3pm. Adoration: Adoration in honour of the Immaculate Conception will take place in the chapel on Tuesday, December 8th from 10.30am to 7.30pm. Please volunteer to spend an hour in adoration by signing one of the sheets in the chapel porches. Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat: Calling all young people aged 16 to 35 to join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare from the 11th to 13th December. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome.
